What we do

Our services

01

Crown Reduction

Careful reduction of the crown's overall size while maintaining the tree's natural form and health.

02

Tree Removal

Safe, efficient removal of trees of all sizes — including tight access situations and stump grinding.

03

Crown Thinning

Selective removal of branches to increase light and airflow without altering the overall shape.

04

Deadwooding

Removal of dead, dying or diseased branches to improve safety and long-term tree health.

05

Hedge Trimming

Precise shaping and maintenance of hedges to keep your property looking sharp year-round.

06

Emergency Call-out

Rapid response for storm-damaged or hazardous trees. Available 7 days a week, any time of year.

About us

Rooted in
the trade.

Cutting Edge Tree Surgery was built on a simple belief: every job, large or small, deserves the same level of care and professionalism. Our NPTC-qualified team brings deep expertise to every project.

We're fully insured with £5 million public liability cover and committed to leaving your property cleaner than we found it — every single time.
